research_notes: The eventual scheduler-gap study should hold the promoted runtime policy fixed while reducing planned gap.
Actual idle gap, not planned gap, is the operational outcome because close overhead and jitter alter it.
If planned gap becomes too small, accidental overlap/concurrency may appear and must be classified separately.
Intentional overlap research can then build on that evidence with explicit authority fencing.
This staged approach preserves causal interpretability across runtime, gap, and parallelism variables.
The present sample changes only runtime target relative to the prior strict baseline.
